1.explanation:
• AccordionItem.js is the core component that renders the chevron and heading; it needs to accept and apply the new `align` prop to reposition the icon.
• Accordion-story.js defines the Storybook stories and knobs; it must be updated so users can toggle and preview the `align` prop in the UI.
• AccordionItem-test.js contains unit tests for AccordionItem’s behavior; tests need new cases to verify that chevron alignment changes when `align` is set.
• The corresponding snapshot file must be updated to reflect the changed markup/markup order when `align='start'` or `end` is used.
1.bug_scenario: In the provided screenshot we see a wrapped Carbon Accordion where each section’s expand/collapse chevron is rendered at the start (left) of the heading—this is the desired “start” alignment when the new `align='start'` prop is passed. However, because the upstream AccordionItem component doesn’t yet support an `align` prop, the chevron always renders at its hard-coded default position. The bug is that the new `align` prop is being ignored and chevrons cannot be flexibly positioned.
